# Runtime UI lint baseline (the UiSnapshot row, docs/ui-style-guide.md section 13).
#
# One ACCEPTED hit per line, exactly as build/ui-snapshots/runtime-lint.txt prints it:
# rule | where | row. These are this project's rows that do not yet follow the SoH
# conventions -- the migration list -- recorded so the row fails on anything NEW.
# The baseline may only SHRINK: a fixed row makes its line stale and the row fails
# until the line is deleted. Never add a line to make the row pass. R2w/R4w are
# warnings and are never listed here.
